stock.description: Omnibridge Holdings Limited functions as an investment holding entity, specializing in delivering a full range of human resources outsourcing and recruitment solutions throughout Singapore and Hong Kong. The company's outsourcing arm focuses on identifying and employing suitable candidates who then execute job responsibilities under the direct guidance of its clients. Furthermore, its recruitment division assists employers in sourcing qualified individuals for positions spanning various organizational tiers, including administrative, executive, managerial, and professional roles, thereby fulfilling their staffing demands. In addition to these core services, Omnibridge provides supplementary human resources support, such as candidate referrals and streamlined payroll processing. Its clientele is diverse, encompassing both public and private sectors, with notable clients including Singapore government agencies and non-profit organizations. Founded in 2016, Omnibridge Holdings Limited maintains its headquarters in Admiralty, Hong Kong, and operates as a subsidiary of Omnipartners Holdings Limited.
